content.text: For digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Zimbabwe, Stripe's restrictions can be a major roadblock to selling digital products online. However, with COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can break free from these limitations and deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, accepting [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-6|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-how-one-creator|Payment Options]]s-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-5|payments]] without relying on Stripe or other platforms. You can create a fully operational online store using the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or opt for the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced features and faster deployment.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages offers a free hosting solution that allows you to deploy a digital store without worrying about platform restrictions. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages as the foundation for your infrastructure, you can bypass the limitations imposed by traditional payment gateways like Stripe. This means you can focus on selling digital products without being held back by geographical or economic restrictions. Moreover, Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script provide a powerful backend logic engine, enabling you to automate tasks, process payments, and store orders efficiently. With NOWPayments integrated, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for multiple payment processors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need the Sovereign Blueprint, which includes complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and NOWPayments integration guides. This blueprint will help you navigate the deployment process and ensure that you have the necessary tools and knowledge to succeed. Additionally, you'll need to create a GitHub account and a Cloudflare account to take advantage of the free hosting and backend logic solutions. Once you have these prerequisites in place, you can proceed with deploying your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can set up a payment and delivery pipeline that's both secure and efficient. This involves configuring your payment gateway, setting up order storage, and automating file delivery. By leveraging Supabase and Google Drive, you can store orders and deliver files to your customers seamlessly, without relying on third-party services. By automating this process, you can save time and resources, allowing you to focus on growing your business and creating more digital products.
Cloudflare Pages offers a free hosting solution that allows you to deploy a digital store without worrying about platform restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves testing your infrastructure, configuring SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and ensuring that your store is fully operational. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), this process is even faster, with deployment taking just 48 hours and end-to-end testing before handoff. By following the Sovereign Blueprint, you can ensure a smooth deployment and avoid any common pitfalls along the way.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet the demands of increased traffic and sales. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers, you can dynamically scale your infrastructure to handle spikes in traffic, ensuring that your store remains fast and responsive. By integrating Supabase and Google Drive, you can also optimize your order storage and file delivery, reducing latency and improving overall performance. With the right infrastructure in place, you can scale your digital store with confidence, knowing that you have the tools and resources needed to succeed.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
With NOWPayments integrated, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for multiple payment processors.

If you're looking for more advanced features and faster deployment, consider opting for the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. Alternatively, you can explore the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for a more affordable entry point into the world of digital commerce. Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: Create a GitHub account and a Cloudflare account to take advantage of the free hosting and backend logic solutions. Acquire the Sovereign Blueprint, which includes complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and NOWPayments integration guides. Set up your payment and delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. Configure your payment gateway, set up order storage, and automate file delivery. Test your infrastructure and configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Deploy your digital store using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97).
